Recognize the approach

Neobrutalism combines assertive graphics with more organized interface conventions.

Look for

  • Heavy outlines
  • Solid offset shadows
  • Bright, clearly separated surfaces

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Neobrutalism combines assertive graphics with more organized interface conventions. Its bold color blocks and hard shadows differ from the stripped-back appearance often associated with web brutalism.

Period or influence
Late 2010s–2020s visibility
What this label describes

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Use consistent border and shadow tokens in CSS.
  2. Reserve space for shadows and focus rings so they do not collide with neighboring content. Test the layout at enlarged text sizes.

Small practice task

Build one button with a solid offset shadow. Make pressing it feel like a small physical movement.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
